text: Input: Description of a corpus, number of users K, number of tasks per user N, number of questions per (user, task) combination M. Output: A set of K * N * M high-level questions. For our evaluation, we set K = M = N = 5 for a total of 125 test questions per dataset.
We selected two datasets: podcast transcripts and news articles. Each dataset is representative of corpora that users may encounter in real-world activities.
